title: Emergency Equity Raise
situation: Investors will pour in cash — but only because the company is performing well enough to be worth saving. The price is ownership: you dilute your stake, bruise your reputation, and shrink any final payout.

options.label: Raise emergency equity
options.description: Large cash injection. Dilutes ownership: reputation hit and a reduced final-score multiplier.
options.outcomeText: Fresh capital floods in — and so do new owners with opinions about your future.
